title: NHK World — マンガとアニメの世界 (The World of Manga and Anime)
description: NHK World examines the global impact of Japanese manga and anime culture. Covers the legacy of Tezuka Osamu, the birth of the first TV anime (Astro Boy, 1963), the worldwide reach of Studio Ghibli films, and the cosplay phenomenon. Interviews with artists and fans at N4 vocabulary level.
